card: Adds explicit test spenders to feature_taproot.py for legacy script edge cases: OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY with negative numbers, 5-byte numeric inputs, OP_IFDUP on non-minimal or negative zeros, OP_ROLL with identical stack values, OP_16 in P2SH scriptSigs, and P2SH scriptSig 1,000-item stack size boundaries. These edge cases were identified from discrepancies in alternative Bitcoin implementations such as bitcoin-s and rbitcoin. Existing test assets lacked these vectors because automated minimizers dropped them when broader code paths were already touched. Merging this enables updated test dumps to be exported to bitcoin-core/qa-assets#297.
changed_since_previous: Added a boundary test case for P2SH scriptSig stack sizes checking the 1,000-item stack limit.
evidence: "These were discovered by finding gaps in alternate implementations (bitcoin-s and rbitcoin)" (PR description)

"None of the current vectors catch an interpreter that gets these wrong. Merging their dumps into the script assets adds new coverage, and a regeneration of the script assets keeps them." (commit 660c159220)
problem: Bitcoin Core's test vectors do not explicitly exercise several legacy script interpreter edge cases. When generating test asset dumps for downstream and alternative implementations, coverage-guided minimizers omit these cases because existing tests hit the relevant code branches without isolating the specific edge conditions.

risk.why: Touches only functional test cases in feature_taproot.py.

summary: Adds explicit test cases to feature_taproot.py covering legacy script edge cases that alternative implementations have historically implemented incorrectly. These include OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY with negative values, 5-byte operands whose values fit in fewer bytes, OP_IFDUP on non-minimal or negative zeros, OP_ROLL on stacks with duplicate values, OP_16 within P2SH scriptSigs, and P2SH scriptSig stack item count boundaries.
